name: Hide
purpose: Hide content through Brick's CSS breakpoint contract without JavaScript viewport state or hydration flicker.
useWhen: One composition should be absent at selected Brick breakpoints while remaining present elsewhere.

avoidWhen.condition: Content should be visually hidden but remain available to assistive technology, or should not render for business reasons.

composition: Wrap the smallest complete region whose presence changes; pair with Show only when desktop and mobile genuinely need distinct compositions.

rules.statement: Use Hide instead of JavaScript matchMedia for first-paint responsive visibility.
Do not hide the only accessible name, error, instruction, or required content at a breakpoint.
Rely on Hide's layout-transparent visible state inside parent layouts and put paint or geometry on a child layout component.
Omit default-valued props such as as=div; use as only for deliberate HTML semantics or valid document structure.
Load styles.css or core.css plus hide.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding application CSS to repair Hide spacing or writing as=div even though div is the default.
commonMistakes.correction: Rely on Hide's layout-transparent default and specify as only when semantics require another host.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Hide without its modular CSS or duplicating two interactive trees with conflicting IDs.
commonMistakes.correction: Load hide.css and verify alternate compositions have independent valid relationships.

validation: Test boundary pixels, zoom, first paint, hydration, focus order, and duplicate IDs across all visibility states.
